prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production concept sheet for the Unity hex strategy game "Истоки", Neolithic E02 buildings. Input image: reference only, existing building gallery screenshot. Generate a new polished model-design sheet, not a screenshot of an implemented game.
Preserve the reference's fixed isometric camera, earthy green hex bases, warm timber/ochre straw/terracotta palette, stylized solid-volume 3D appearance and readable silhouettes. Improve geometric detail noticeably: layered thatch, joinery, bindings, carved timber, woven panels, roof thickness, tools and useful props; subtle faceting, restrained textures, daylight from upper left. No photorealism, no flat cartoon painting, no modern masonry or metal tools.
Landscape 3 by 3 catalog grid of NINE fully separated large isometric miniatures on matching thin hex bases, all entirely in frame, ample margins on a clean dark forest-green studio background. Camera and lighting consistent. Readable Russian label under each, no UI or statistics. Exact objects left to right, top to bottom:
1 "ДЛИННЫЙ ДОМ": long rectangular timber and wattle dwelling, elongated steep thick straw roof, two simple doorways, structural posts, small baskets, recognizable long silhouette.
2 "ПЛОТНИЦКАЯ": open wooden shed, workbench, partially shaped timbers, tied stone axe, joints and log pile, pale fresh cut wood.
3 "ТКАЦКАЯ": open-front thatched hut showing a large vertical loom with taut threads, hanging pale linen, spindle weights, wool baskets.
4 "КРУГ СОВЕТА": circular seats made from logs under a partial wood-and-thatch canopy, central meeting space, carved speaker post; no fantasy throne.
5 "СВЯТИЛИЩЕ": small ancestor shrine, carved posts, rough stone markers, bowls, offerings and modest contained hearth.
6 "ПАЛИСАД": gateway between chunky pointed timber wall sections, rope lashings, small watch platform and wooden steps, distinct large fortified silhouette.
7 "КАМЕНЬ ПАМЯТИ": one substantial carved standing stone with simple non-alphabetic motifs, small stones and a clear gathering area.
8 "АМБАР": elevated timber and woven grain store on posts, thick roof, ramp, covered grain baskets, recognizably storage rather than a second house.
9 "ГОНЧАРНАЯ": open-front workshop with clay vessels drying on racks, hand-building table, modest earthen firing hearth, terracotta vessels of varied shape, no steel equipment.
Keep sparse ground decoration. Building silhouettes occupy most of their hex, no dense tiny grass clutter. All models should be credible geometry references for our detailed stylized Unity art, architecture mechanically legible at gameplay scale. No extra buildings, no game HUD, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: new E02 unit and animation design sheet for our Unity hex strategy "Истоки". Input images: 1 new building sheet is the approved-for-this-sheet material/style reference; 2 current shepherd model is a reference for the stylized human proportions only. Create a new design, not a game screenshot.
Detailed stylized 3D miniatures with solid polygonal forms, earthy ochre cloth, pale linen, wood, rope, flint/stone, soft daylight upper left. Fixed orthographic isometric three-quarter camera, clean dark forest-green background. Match the building sheet's warm material palette and high geometric craftsmanship. Humans have readable faces and anatomically recognizable fingers, articulated elbows/knees, slightly enlarged heads but no bobbleheads. No fantasy armor, no shiny metal, no modern clothes, no bow, no horses.
Wide landscape production sheet with two clearly separated groups. Left half: "КОПЕЙЩИК ОБЩИНЫ" exact Russian title and three full-body views of ONE consistent male spearman: front-three-quarter ready stance, rear-three-quarter view, and a forward thrust action pose. Adult in simple ochre linen/woven tunic, leather belt, wrist bindings, sandals, tied dark hair. Tall wooden spear with clearly visible rough gray FLINT STONE point bound with cord; round wooden plank shield with rawhide edging and woven straps. The rear view reveals shield straps and garment seams. Every spear tip, foot and shield fully in frame. Small circular ground pads keep the models separated. No blades of bronze or steel.
Right half: "ЛОДКА-ПЕРЕВОЗЧИК" exact Russian title. Two isometric views of the SAME elongated hollowed single-log dugout canoe, rounded natural irregular wood grain, thick rim, two wooden cross-seat supports, wooden paddles, rope bindings and one small cargo bundle. One view shows the unoccupied boat for clear construction; the other shows a seated paddler plus ONE seated passenger with a travel bundle, all legs inside the canoe and practical seating. Tiny flat blue water base under boat, no sail, no second hull, no enormous raft or ocean ship. Passenger distinct from paddler. Clear contrast of outside silhouette and hollow interior. Balanced layout, whitespace between all views, sparse ground props. No UI, no stats, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: E02 resident professions and work-action model sheet for Unity hex strategy "Истоки". Input images: 1 building catalog for materials, 2 unit sheet for exact character art direction. New production drawing; not an implemented-game screenshot.
Match the references: detailed stylized solid-volume 3D models, natural human proportions with slightly enlarged expressive heads, articulated hands and limbs, warm ochre and pale linen clothing, wood, woven baskets, terracotta and stone tools, soft upper-left daylight, dark forest-green studio background. Fixed isometric three-quarter camera. Landscape 4-column by 2-row grid of EIGHT separate full-body working characters with their compact workplace props. All feet, tools and props fully in frame, no overlapping cells. Mixed adult men and women, distinguishable faces and hair, no invented armor or modern clothing. Simple small green ground pads; sparse incidental grass.
Exact row-major subjects and readable Russian labels:
1 "ФЕРМЕР": person bent slightly, using a wooden-handled stone hoe correctly at a few visible earth furrows, seed basket beside them.
2 "ПАСТУХ": person standing with crook beside TWO small stylized sheep and ONE goat, animals anatomically readable, pale wool and small horns; the herd is close and part of the workplace.
3 "ГОНЧАР": seated person hand-shaping a clay vessel, both hands on the clay, small work table, drying pots and modest earthen firing mound nearby, no powered machinery.
4 "ПЛОТНИК": person using a lash-bound gray stone axe on timber on a wooden workbench, wood curls and cut logs in small quantity.
5 "ТКАЧ": seated person at a vertical loom with clearly separated threads, one hand manipulating the thread/wooden shuttle, roll of pale fabric and wool basket.
6 "ДОБЫТЧИК ГЛИНЫ": person digging a small exposed patch of clay using a wooden digging spade, clay chunks in a basket, NO steel shovel.
7 "СТАРЕЙШИНА": older adult seated on a low wood-and-woven seat, expressive speaking hand, wooden staff and small meeting marker, no crown or fantasy wizard robe.
8 "ХРАНИТЕЛЬ СВЯТИЛИЩА": person tending bowls/offerings at a small rough stone marker and modest contained flame, simple necklace, calm gestures, no magic effects.
Tools must visibly make contact with the work. Appropriate hand grips; no floating tools or duplicate limbs. Character design remains compatible across professions as clothing/prop variants of one game rig. Clear silhouettes at strategy camera scale; avoid tiny noisy props. No UI, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: E02 resource and tile-improvement concept sheet for Unity hex strategy "Истоки". Input images: 1 current detailed forest hex is a reference for hex shape/isometric perspective/nature, 2 new building sheet is the art and material reference. Generate new designs in the same family.
Landscape 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX fully isolated thin hexagonal miniatures, clean dark forest-green background, consistent orthographic isometric view and upper-left sunlight. Detailed stylized 3D geometry, earthy olive green land, soft faceted soil, natural wood, sparse small decoration. Gameplay scale legibility, not photorealistic macro images. No people, buildings or gameplay UI. Entire hex sides visible and no crops cut off.
Exact row-major objects with these Russian labels:
1 "ЗЕРНОВОЕ ПОЛЕ": modest organized crop plot occupying most of a meadow hex, several clear earth furrows, groups of golden grain at varying heights, one small bundle of harvested stalks and a seed basket. Sparse wooden corner stakes. Visually readable crops, not a dense lawn.
2 "ПАСТБИЩЕ": fenced open grass clearing with TWO sheep, ONE goat, ONE small cattle animal of different sizes, small trough, pasture gate. Animals distinct solid-volume models with faces, legs, tails and horns; most ground remains open.
3 "ГЛИНЯНАЯ ВЫРАБОТКА": shallow irregular terracotta-colored clay deposit dug into one hex, exposed clay banks and chunks of different size, wooden digging spade, baskets. No deep mine, no steel pickaxe, no masoned walls.
4 "ЛЬНЯНОЙ УЧАСТОК": green crop plot with tall slender flax stalks and small BLUE flowers in clear rows, a few cut tied stems, pale fiber bundles drying on a low wooden rack; recognizably different from grain.
5 "ЛЕСНАЯ ДЕЛЯНКА": wooded hex with three varied mature trees retained at back and sides, a small working clearing containing rough logs, one stump, tied stone axe and modest saw-horse-style wood supports. Forest remains recognizable, not a completely clearcut tile.
6 "ОРОШАЕМОЕ ПОЛЕ": same grain-field family as tile 1 with clearly visible SHALLOW NARROW irrigation ditches between some earth beds. A natural river runs smoothly along just ONE OUTSIDE hex edge; a tiny intake notch connects this existing river to the ditches. The river does not bisect every row; ditches are visibly narrower than the natural river. Small wooden footbridge over the ditch and a basket. Do not create new broad rivers from the field.
Consistent base thickness and scale for all six. Surface detail should convey the improvement, not random excessive tiny grass and pebbles. No fantasy resources, no snow, no tractors, no metal machinery, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hero asset concept for the unique E02 wonder "Священная роща" in Unity hex strategy "Истоки". Input images: 1 current forest hex for tree variety and game setting; 2 building sheet for architecture/materials and fixed isometric camera. Generate a new standalone wonder design with greater geometric detail, still visibly part of this game's asset family.
A single fully visible thin grassy HEXAGONAL tile shown in orthographic isometric three-quarter view, centered large on dark forest-green studio backdrop. Detailed stylized solid 3D geometry, soft faceting, warm daylight from upper left, soft realistic contact shadows, earthy greens, ochre wood and straw, gray stone, terracotta. Not a photoreal forest painting, not a fantasy illustration.
Unique sacred grove recognizable from strategy-camera distance. Three large mature trees of visibly varied species and canopy shapes frame the BACK and SIDES of the hex, leaving a wide clear central gathering area and front entrance. Rich layered crowns, textured trunks with sculptural roots and branches, individual leaf clusters without noisy tiny particles. A circular/curving low woven wood fence follows part of the clearing, with a small OPEN entrance at front. A few tall carved timber posts tied with cord, simple spiral/diamond motifs rather than real alphabetic writing. Several rough gray standing stones of varying forms, bowls of offerings and pottery, low wooden seats arranged facing the center. Central rough stone pedestal and small contained hearth; modest warm fire, no giant flame or magic glow. Two simple hanging clay fire-lamp bowls on separate posts, no electric or metal lanterns. One path leads from the front entrance through the clearing; modest patches of forest ground plants around tree roots, very sparse stones elsewhere.
Two or three small adult villagers in matching pale linen and ochre clothing gathering calmly, making the scale readable without obscuring the architecture. No crowds, no duplicated heads. All trees and the entire hex boundary in frame, foliage must not conceal the ritual clearing. Avoid temple roofs, large masonry buildings, metal tools, neon magic, statues of deities, dramatic cinematic fog.
Exact readable Russian caption centered BELOW the tile on the background: "СВЯЩЕННАЯ РОЩА". No other text, UI, stats or watermark. A beautiful feasible model reference for a distinctive one-hex world wonder.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached six-tile E02 concept sheet. Correct ONLY two tools so they unambiguously fit our pre-metal game equipment. In the top-right clay extraction tile replace the shiny gray metal-looking shovel blade with a broad thick WOODEN digging blade, same brown wood as its shaft, wood grain and a cord-lashed joint clearly visible. In the bottom-middle logging tile replace the thin gray axe blade with a bulky irregular flint STONE axe head, chipped stone edges, bound tightly to the wooden handle by several visible rope turns. Preserve ALL six tile models, their positions, camera, lighting, background, hex bases, crops, trees, animals, river and ditches exactly. Preserve every existing Russian label verbatim, including "ГЛИНЯНАЯ ВЫРАБОТКА" and "ЛЕСНАЯ ДЕЛЯНКА". Do not add, remove or rearrange any other object. No metal tools anywhere. Same detailed stylized 3D render.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the eight-profession resident sheet. Change ONLY the axe held by the carpenter in the TOP RIGHT panel "ПЛОТНИК": it currently reads as a thin manufactured metal blade. Make its head a thick chunky irregular chipped gray FLINT STONE axe with clear rough knapped facets, no shiny thin straight metal edge, bound to the same wooden handle by visible cord lashings. Maintain his exact pose and hand positions, the blade still touches his timber workpiece. Also make the digging blade in the bottom-row "ДОБЫТЧИК ГЛИНЫ" panel unambiguously thick BROWN WOOD with wood grain rather than metal; preserve that person's pose and handle. Preserve all eight characters, their faces, clothes, animals, workplaces, geometry elsewhere, arrangement, isometric camera, lighting, palette, background and ALL Russian labels verbatim. No other changes, no added figures, no metal equipment.
